name: side-lying oblique crunch with straight-leg lift
description: A side-lying crunch that lifts straight legs while the upper shoulder curls toward the hip.
instructions: Lie on one side with your legs straight and stacked, using the lower arm for support.
Place your upper hand lightly behind your head.
Lift your legs slightly and curl your upper shoulder toward your hip without yanking your neck.
Lower with control, then switch sides after the set.
